name: Prologue
subtitle: The fall
brief: Cold open. You fall out of a night sky for no reason the game will explain yet, crash into a wood beside a castle hanging off a cliff, and find the Key ringing in the dirt. About three minutes, mostly pictures.

scenes.title: The title screen
scenes.brief: Continue, new game, chapters, and the workshop (free play and the editor). The 3D note-key from Timothy's site spins over the first room. It notices when you come back.
notes: The title could play the Wood's overture instead of the castle's motif, so the first thing heard is the first place you go.

scenes.title: The fall
scenes.brief: A night sky. A speck tumbling through it, then you, with the Key falling beside you. The castle on its cliff seen from far above, then the trees coming up fast. Black.
notes: Rough storyboard: every drawing here is a code sketch standing in for Timothy's.
Should the fall be playable (steer toward the castle, collect notes on the way down)? It would teach the D-pad before anything else.

shots.say: Somewhere above the Wood, something is falling.
Below you: a wood, a cliff, and a castle hanging off the edge of it, the way a held note hangs off the end of a bar.

scenes.title: The landing
scenes.brief: You in a crater. A ringing in your ears, one note, held. Something in the dirt rings the same note.

shots.say: Ringing. Just the one note, in your ears, for a long time.
Something half-buried in the dirt is ringing the same note.

scenes.title: The Composer's Key
scenes.name: the Composer's Key
scenes.say: You found the Composer's Key! Press A and it sings: a wave of sound that travels, and plays whatever it reaches. Nothing it plays can be out of key.
scenes.brief: The first item, held overhead. Unlocks A. The Key's design is from Timothy's concept art (the twisted shaft, the three note loops, the teardrop with spirals).
